dog.description_text:
Hi I’m Dudley! I’m a very distinguished gentleman who doesn’t let my lack of teeth slow me down. While I love to spend most of my day finding a cozy spot to snooze, I also love to go on walks to explore outside and really get to experience the smells of NYC. I also love soft toys! I don’t have the teeth to chew them up anymore, but I love to give them a gummy chew or chase them around when my foster mum throws them for me. I’m excellent when left alone and not phased by the sights and sounds of the city. I’m housetrained and know to do my business outside, but when adapting to a new place I will mark a bit inside at first (but I don’t mind wearing a belly band!). I’m currently living with another senior pup and while I’m curious about him, I respect that he has told me he doesn’t want to play. I’m a 10/10 good boy and can’t wait to meet my forever family

﻿Dudley is approximately 12y 1m 3d old and is fully grown at 13 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
